resources.string: On the family dashboard at home, an admin opens Devices and shows the setup code. Scan it, then sign in with the client\'s username and password. Your rules and time budget come with that sign-in. Your password is not saved on this device.
Tap Allow VPN connection. Android then asks whether Temperance may set up a VPN connection. Tap OK so your family\'s rules apply on this device.
Without the VPN, family rules cannot apply on this device. Tap Allow VPN connection to try again.
Admins: so the VPN can\'t be switched off, open the menu, choose Always-on VPN settings, and turn on Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN.
Why do you need more time?
Parents can now ask for this device\'s location.
Is this a client\'s device, or are you an admin? A client\'s device installs the family VPN. An admin\'s phone opens the family dashboard from anywhere, with no VPN.
This is a client\'s device instead
On the family dashboard at home, open Devices → Admin devices and tap Pair an admin device. Then scan the code, or paste the link.
Temperance needs the camera to scan the code. You can paste the link instead.
Point the camera at the code on the dashboard
This code sets up a client\'s device. To pair an admin\'s phone, scan the code under Devices → Admin devices.
This code pairs an admin\'s phone. To set up a client\'s device, scan the code under Devices.
This is not a Temperance pairing code. Scan the code under Devices → Admin devices.
This isn\'t a device setup code. Scan the code under Devices → Set up a client\'s device.
This phone will stop opening the family dashboard. To use it again, pair it from the dashboard at home.
